name: dental-practice-rebuild
rationale: A frozen, representative rebuild target. V2 measured mapping accuracy against the live VerticalFramework theme's ACF arrays, so a regression and a theme change were indistinguishable (V3 guide F-5). This schema is deliberately committed, small, and VerticalFramework-shaped without being VerticalFramework: a real theme's catalog is read into this same shape by the WordPress adapter, so the interpreter never sees a live schema.

fields.label: Title
fields.purpose: The page title shown in the browser tab and as the H1 fallback.

fields.label: Slug
fields.purpose: URL slug for the page.

fields.label: Hero heading
fields.purpose: The large headline in the hero band at the top of the page.

fields.label: Hero subheading
fields.purpose: Supporting line under the hero headline.

fields.label: Hero CTA label
fields.purpose: Button text for the hero call to action.

fields.label: Hero CTA link
fields.purpose: Destination for the hero call to action button.

fields.label: Hero background
fields.purpose: Full-width background image behind the hero band.

fields.label: Intro heading
fields.purpose: Heading introducing the body copy under the hero.

fields.label: Intro body
fields.purpose: The opening paragraphs of body copy under the hero.

fields.label: Feature cards
fields.purpose: A row of linked cards promoting other pages or services.

sub_fields.label: Card body
sub_fields.purpose: One or two sentences of card copy.

sub_fields.label: Card link
sub_fields.purpose: Where the card sends the visitor.

fields.label: Current offers
fields.purpose: Time-limited promotions or discounts advertised on the page.

sub_fields.label: Offer
sub_fields.purpose: The promotion as written for patients.

fields.label: SEO title
fields.purpose: Search engine result title. Distinct from the on-page H1.

fields.label: SEO description
fields.purpose: Search engine result snippet.

fields.label: Robots directive
fields.purpose: Indexing directive carried over from the source page.

fields.label: Canonical URL
fields.purpose: Canonical URL if the source declared one.

fields.label: Name
fields.purpose: The person's full name as patients see it.

fields.label: Role
fields.purpose: Job title, e.g. Registered Dental Hygienist.

fields.label: Biography
fields.purpose: Several paragraphs about the person's background and manner.

fields.label: Photo
fields.purpose: Headshot of the person.

fields.label: Pull quote
fields.purpose: A quotation from the person, displayed emphasised.

fields.label: Service name
fields.purpose: Name of the treatment or service.

fields.label: Summary
fields.purpose: One-sentence description used in listings.

fields.label: Description
fields.purpose: Full description of the service.

fields.label: Phone
fields.purpose: Primary practice telephone number.

fields.label: Fax
fields.purpose: Practice fax number.

fields.label: Email
fields.purpose: Public contact email address.

fields.label: Address
fields.purpose: Street address of the practice.

fields.label: Social links
fields.purpose: Links to the practice's social profiles.

notes: Site chrome (phone, address, email, social) belongs to the practice_info singleton, not to each page. An interpreter that maps the footer phone number onto every page is wrong, and the eval scores that as a precision failure.
team_member has cardinality one_per_person. One source URL therefore legitimately yields five entities, which the current V2 recommendation contract cannot express - see expected-mappings.json.
